The <ruby>crimson spider<rt>Muramasa</rt></ruby> through the skylight. The <ruby>longhorn beetle<rt>Masamune</rt></ruby> mercilessly smashing the glass.

en.html:
ｅｔｃ／十傑Ｂ"Hmph. Reckless. Put it down to youth, and it is almost endearing."
ｅｔｃ／十傑Ｃ"We are the reverse. Every scheme exhausted, every prospect of victory reinforced with another: then we fight."
ｅｔｃ／十傑Ｄ"Hence the supremacy of Oyumi's Ten Heroes."
Ichijou"What rubbish. Your scheme failed, that's why we're standing here like this. Speeches over. Come on."
稲田"Heh, heh, heh...! Failed? You call this failure?"
稲田"Nothing has failed yet. You drinking that tea would have finished matters quicker, certainly."
Kageaki"Poison..."
稲田"I expected little from it. The real scheme begins—now."

She said it with appalling indolence. At least no misunderstanding was possible.

Ichijou and I were to <ruby>behead<rt>behead</rt></ruby> each other.

...What could I do?

Unacceptable. That needed no consideration.

But refusal was impossible too. Say anything meaning no, and at least one hostage would die on the spot.

Choose my words carefully. Negotiate.

No... dangerous even then. To an offer of negotiation, their likeliest reply was rejection by killing one hostage.

Two would remain. Quite enough to keep threatening us.

Three hostages. A cunning number.

Must we accept? Two die, three live: not a bad calculation.

But Ichijou could not die. At worst... leave what followed to her, give them my own head. But...

—No.

Then Silver Star—

en.text:
Positive Pole, applied within oneself, accelerates the armor's movements. Negative Pole, applied to its surface, raises a barrier against attack.

Subject a target to both at once, and it reaches perfect stability・・・・・ magnetically. It cannot move at all.

Those blades should have swept across the hostages' throats the instant we acted against them...◆now, not a twitch.

But I could maintain this for one instant only. An art meant for a single body—my own—and difficult to sustain even then, spread over all this area.

Before one breath was done, the deadlock would end.

That was everything she had asked of me.

Because it was enough.

To win.

自己の内部へ施し、騎体動作を高速化する磁装正極。
　自己の外皮へ施し、攻撃を防ぐ障壁を張る磁装負極。

　この二術を同時に施された対象は、
　磁力的に完全な安定・・・・・を迎えてしまい、一切、身動き
がとれなくなる。

　こちらの敵対行動に反応して即座に人質の首を薙ぐ
筈だった刃は……◆今、ぴくりとも動かない。

　だが――この状態を保てるのは本当に一瞬である。
　本来は自己一体のみを対象とし、それでも長時間の
維持は難しい術を、これだけ広範囲に広げているのだ。

　一呼吸にも満たない一瞬で、この膠着は終わる。
　
　
　彼女が俺に求めたものは、それで全てだった。

　それで充分だったから。
　勝利するために。
